holidays.name: Sun Celebration
holidays.longDescription: Sun Celebration is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Equestrian Calendar. It is classified as a festival and is associated with Celestia raises sun with ceremony . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
